## Constants and helper functions

```{r helpers}

# RefSeq accession → chromosome name for T2T-CHM13v2.0 (defined once, reused throughout)
refseq_to_chr <- c(
  "NC_060925.1" = "1",  "NC_060926.1" = "2",  "NC_060927.1" = "3",
  "NC_060928.1" = "4",  "NC_060929.1" = "5",  "NC_060930.1" = "6",
  "NC_060931.1" = "7",  "NC_060932.1" = "8",  "NC_060933.1" = "9",
  "NC_060934.1" = "10", "NC_060935.1" = "11", "NC_060936.1" = "12",
  "NC_060937.1" = "13", "NC_060938.1" = "14", "NC_060939.1" = "15",
  "NC_060940.1" = "16", "NC_060941.1" = "17", "NC_060942.1" = "18",
  "NC_060943.1" = "19", "NC_060944.1" = "20", "NC_060945.1" = "21",
  "NC_060946.1" = "22", "NC_060947.1" = "X",  "NC_060948.1" = "Y"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute total CDS or exon length (non-redundant) + genomic gene span per gene.
#   txdb       : TxDb object
#   gene_list  : character vector of gene IDs to subset
#   feature    : "cds" or "exon"
# Returns a data.frame with columns: gene, total_<feature>_length_bp, total_gene_length_bp
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_feature_length <- function(txdb, gene_list, feature = c("cds", "exon")) {
  feature <- match.arg(feature)

  # Gene span
  genes_gr     <- genes(txdb)
  genes_sub    <- genes_gr[mcols(genes_gr)$gene_id %in% gene_list]
  gene_span_df <- data.frame(
    gene                 = mcols(genes_sub)$gene_id,
    total_gene_length_bp = width(genes_sub)
  )

  # Feature (CDS or exon) length — reduce to remove transcript-level duplicates
  feat_by_gene <- if (feature == "cds") cdsBy(txdb, by = "gene") else exonsBy(txdb, by = "gene")
  feat_gr      <- feat_by_gene[names(feat_by_gene) %in% gene_list]
  total_len    <- sum(width(reduce(feat_gr)))

  len_col  <- if (feature == "cds") "total_cds_length_bp" else "total_exon_length_bp"
  feat_df  <- data.frame(gene = names(total_len), len = as.numeric(total_len))
  names(feat_df)[2] <- len_col
  rownames(feat_df) <- NULL

  feat_df %>% left_join(gene_span_df, join_by(gene))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Count unique PAM sites per gene from a spacer data frame.
# Expects columns: gene_id, pam_site
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
count_pam_per_gene <- function(spacer_df) {
  spacer_df %>%
    distinct(gene_id, pam_site) %>%
    count(gene_id, name = "num_pam_site")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute PAM-site density (PAM sites per kb of CDS) for a set of genes.
#   spacer_df : output of read_csv for spacer data (needs gene_id, pam_site)
#   cds_df    : output of calculate_feature_length(..., feature = "cds")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_pam_density <- function(spacer_df, cds_df) {
  count_pam_per_gene(spacer_df) %>%
    left_join(cds_df, join_by(gene_id == gene)) %>%
    mutate(pam_density = num_pam_site / total_cds_length_bp * 1000)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Binned barplot: percentage of genes per bin.
#   data      : data.frame containing the bin column
#   bin_col   : column name (string) that holds the bin factor
#   xlabel    : x-axis label
#   ylim_max  : upper y-axis limit (default 50)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_bin_barplot <- function(data, bin_col, xlabel, ylim_max = 50) {
  df <- data %>%
    count(.data[[bin_col]], name = "num_genes") %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(num_genes / sum(num_genes) * 100, 2))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[bin_col]], y = percentage)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#1E88E5") +
    geom_text(aes(label = percentage), nudge_y = 2, size = 7) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = xlabel, y = "Percentage of genes (%)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(t = 20), colour = "black"),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(r = 20), colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(size = 1),
      axis.ticks.length  = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      axis.line.y.right  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y.right  = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x        = element_line(size = 0.5, colour = "black"),
      axis.line.y        = element_line(size = 0.5, colour = "black"),
      panel.grid.major   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "none",
      plot.margin        = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
    ) +
    ylim(0, ylim_max)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Log10-transformed boxplot comparing removed vs control genes with
# Wilcoxon significance annotation and per-group n labels.
#   combined_df  : data.frame with columns gene_status (factor), <y_col>
#   y_col        : column name string for the log10-transformed variable
#   ylabel       : y-axis label
#   sig_label_y  : y position of significance bracket (default 4)
#   ylim_range   : c(ymin, ymax) for y-axis limits (default c(0, 5))
# Returns a ggplot object (does NOT save — call ggsave() separately).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_log10_boxplot <- function(combined_df, y_col, ylabel, sig_label_y = 4, ylim_range = c(0, 5)) {

  p <- ggboxplot(combined_df,
                 x        = "gene_status",
                 y        = y_col,
                 fill     = "gene_status",
                 outliers = FALSE) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons  = list(c("removed genes", "control genes")),
      method       = "wilcox.test",
      method.args  = list(alternative = "two.sided"),
      size         = 5, step.increase = 0.05, tip.length = 0.01,
      label        = "p.signif", label.y = sig_label_y
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name   = "",
      values = c("control genes" = "#1E88E5", "removed genes" = "#E69F00"),
      labels = c("Other protein-coding genes", "Common genes with < 3 sgRNAs")
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = ylabel) +
    theme(
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 25, 10),
      strip.text.x      = element_text(size = 17.5),
      axis.text.x       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 17.5, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.y      = element_line(size = 1.5),
      axis.ticks.x      = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 17.5, vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(r = 20)),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x       = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.line.y       = element_line(size = 0.5),
      line              = element_line(size = 2, colour = "black"),
      legend.position   = "top",
      legend.direction  = "vertical",
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 13)
    ) +
    ylim(ylim_range[1], ylim_range[2])

  # Add n labels just below the lower whisker of each group
  stats    <- ggplot_build(p)$data[[1]]
  count_df <- combined_df %>%
    distinct() %>%
    count(gene_status) %>%
    bind_cols(stats %>% dplyr::select(x, ymin))

  p + geom_text(
    data  = count_df,
    aes(x = x, y = ymin - 0.5, label = paste0("n= ", n)),
    angle = 45, vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 6
  )
}
```

## Import data

```{r import-data}

removed_genes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "removed_genes_survey", "removed_genes_all_library.csv"))

removed_gene_list_combined <- list(
  Avana    = na.omit(removed_genes[["avana_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Brunello = na.omit(removed_genes[["brunello_removed_genes_all"]]),
  TKOv3    = na.omit(removed_genes[["toronto_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Yusa     = na.omit(removed_genes[["yusa_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Jacquere = na.omit(removed_genes[["jacquere_removed_genes_all"]])
)

# 520 protein-coding genes removed across all 5 CRISPR-KO libraries
removed_genes_all_libraries <- unique(Reduce(intersect, removed_gene_list_combined))

# Import pre-computed spacer/CDS/PAM-site data for removed and control genes
all_spacers_cds_removed_genes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "removed_genes_survey", "all_spacers_cds_data_499_removed_genes.csv"))
all_spacers_cds_control_genes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "removed_genes_survey", "all_spacers_cds_data_18777_genes.csv"))

# Pre-compute PAM counts (reused in barplots, boxplots, and density sections)
removed_pam_count <- count_pam_per_gene(all_spacers_cds_removed_genes)
control_pam_count <- count_pam_per_gene(all_spacers_cds_control_genes)
```

## Hypothesis 1: removed genes may be hard to target

First, build the T2T-CHM13 TxDb file (one-time setup — skip if already done).

```{r create-txdb, eval=FALSE}

T2T_txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(
  file       = here::here("data", "annotation", "GCF_009914755.1_T2T-CHM13v2.0_genomic.gff.gz"),
  dataSource = "NCBI T2T Assembly GCF_009914755.1_T2T-CHM13v2.0",
  organism   = "Homo sapiens"
)
saveDb(T2T_txdb, here::here("data", "T2T_data", "TxDb_T2T-CHM13v2.sqlite"))

```

## Compute CDS lengths and gene spans for removed and control genes

```{r compute-cds-lengths}

T2T_txdb <- loadDb(here::here("data", "T2T_data", "TxDb_T2T-CHM13v2.sqlite"))

# 499 removed genes (out of 520) mapped to T2T-CHM13; 5 genes lost due to annotation issues
# (KRTAP5-1, KRTAP5-10, PLA2G10, TAS2R43, UPK3BL1)
removed_genes_cds <- calculate_feature_length(T2T_txdb, unique(all_spacers_cds_removed_genes$gene_id), feature = "cds")

# 18,562 control genes (out of 18,777) mapped to T2T-CHM13
control_genes_cds <- calculate_feature_length(T2T_txdb, unique(all_spacers_cds_control_genes$gene_id), feature = "cds")

```

## Obtain possible protospacer sites from CDS of removed genes

```{r find-protospacers}

# Subset canonical CDS ranges for removed genes
cds_by_gene <- cdsBy(T2T_txdb, by = "gene")
cds_gr      <- cds_by_gene[names(cds_by_gene) %in% removed_genes_all_libraries]

# Keep only canonical NP transcripts
cds_gr <- endoapply(cds_gr, function(gr) gr[str_detect(gr$cds_name, "NP")])

# Remap RefSeq seqlevels to chromosome numbers
seqlevels(cds_gr) <- refseq_to_chr[seqlevels(cds_gr)]
cds_gr <- keepSeqlevels(cds_gr, seqlevels(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0),
                        pruning.mode = "coarse")

# Flatten for overlap joining
cds_flat         <- unlist(cds_gr, use.names = FALSE)
cds_flat$gene_id <- rep(names(cds_gr), elementNROWS(cds_gr))
df_cds_flat      <- as.data.frame(cds_flat)

# Reduce (de-duplicate isoform-shared exons) before spacer search
cds_reduced <- unlist(reduce(split(cds_flat, cds_flat$gene_id)), use.names = FALSE)

# Find all SpCas9 protospacers within CDS
data(SpCas9, package = "crisprBase")
cds_find_spacer <- findSpacers(cds_reduced,
                               bsgenome      = BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0,
                               crisprNuclease = SpCas9)

hits <- findOverlaps(cds_find_spacer, cds_flat, type = "within")

all_spacers_cds_data <- data.frame(
  gene_id      = cds_flat$gene_id[subjectHits(hits)],
  cds_id       = cds_flat$cds_id[subjectHits(hits)],
  spacer_chr   = as.character(seqnames(cds_find_spacer)[queryHits(hits)]),
  spacer_strand = as.character(strand(cds_find_spacer)[queryHits(hits)]),
  pam          = cds_find_spacer$pam[queryHits(hits)],
  pam_site     = cds_find_spacer$pam_site[queryHits(hits)],
  cut_site     = cds_find_spacer$cut_site[queryHits(hits)],
  spacer_seq   = cds_find_spacer$protospacer[queryHits(hits)],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(df_cds_flat, join_by(gene_id, cds_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(seqnames, strand)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(start_cds  = start,
                end_cds    = end,
                chromosome = spacer_chr,
                strand     = spacer_strand) %>%
  relocate(cds_name, .before = start_cds)

write_csv(all_spacers_cds_data, here::here("data", "removed_genes_survey", "all_spacers_cds_data_499_removed_genes.csv"))
```

## CDS length analysis: removed vs control genes

From 520 removed genes, 5 are not mapped to T2T-CHM13 (KRTAP5-1, KRTAP5-10, PLA2G10, TAS2R43, UPK3BL1) — likely annotation or symbol issues.

### Supp Figure 3A and 3B: Barplot distribution of total CDS length

```{r cds-length-barplot}

cds_bins   <- c(0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, Inf)
cds_labels <- c("0–500", "500–1000", "1000–1500", "1500–2000", "2000–2500", ">2500")

removed_genes_cds$cds_length_bin <- cut(removed_genes_cds$total_cds_length_bp,
                                        breaks = cds_bins, labels = cds_labels,
                                        right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE)

control_genes_cds$cds_length_bin <- cut(control_genes_cds$total_cds_length_bp,
                                        breaks = cds_bins, labels = cds_labels,
                                        right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE)

barplot_cds_removed <- make_bin_barplot(
  removed_genes_cds, "cds_length_bin", "Total CDS length (bp)"
)
barplot_cds_control <- make_bin_barplot(
  control_genes_cds, "cds_length_bin", "Total CDS length (bp)"
)

ggsave(here::here("figure", "SuppFig3A_cds_length_499_removed_genes.png"),
       plot = barplot_cds_removed, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 1000)

ggsave(here::here("figure", "SuppFig3B_cds_length_18562_control_genes.png"),
       plot = barplot_cds_control, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 1000)
```

### Figure 3C: Boxplot log10 CDS length — removed vs control

```{r cds-length-boxplot}

combined_cds <- bind_rows(
  removed_genes_cds %>% mutate(gene_status = "removed genes",
                                log_transform_cds_length = log10(total_cds_length_bp)),
  control_genes_cds %>% mutate(gene_status = "control genes",
                                log_transform_cds_length = log10(total_cds_length_bp))
) %>%
  mutate(gene_status = factor(gene_status, levels = c("control genes", "removed genes")))

cds_length_boxplot <- make_log10_boxplot(
  combined_cds,
  y_col  = "log_transform_cds_length",
  ylabel = "log10-transformed total CDS length (bp)"
)
cds_length_boxplot

ggsave(here::here("figure", "Fig3C_log10_cds_length_removed_genes.png"),
       plot = cds_length_boxplot, width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 1000)
```

```{r wilcoxon-fig3c}

# Fig 3C: Wilcoxon rank-sum test (unpaired, two-sided)
# Comparison: log10(CDS length) of removed genes vs control genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# W = 6,153,776    p = 3.87e-36
# Median log10 CDS length — removed genes : 2.97 (≈ 937 bp)
# Median log10 CDS length — control genes : 3.15 (≈ 1,400 bp)
# n removed = 499    n control = 18,562

wt_fig3c <- wilcox.test(log_transform_cds_length ~ gene_status,
                         data        = combined_cds,
                         alternative = "two.sided")
cat("Fig 3C  W =", wt_fig3c$statistic, " p =", wt_fig3c$p.value, "\n")
combined_cds %>%
  group_by(gene_status) %>%
  summarise(median_log10_cds = median(log_transform_cds_length, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n())

```

```{r wilcoxon-fig3d}

# Fig 3D: Wilcoxon rank-sum test (unpaired, two-sided)
# Comparison: log10(PAM count) of removed genes vs control genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# W = 6,354,039    p = 8.74e-46
# Median log10 PAM count — removed genes : 1.77 (≈ 59 PAM sites)
# Median log10 PAM count — control genes : 2.00 (≈ 99 PAM sites)

wt_fig3d <- wilcox.test(log_transform_num_pam_site ~ gene_status,
                         data        = combined_pam,

            n = n())
```

## PAM-site density relative to CDS length

Does a larger CDS simply provide more PAM sites?

```{r pam-density}

removed_genes_density <- compute_pam_density(all_spacers_cds_removed_genes, removed_genes_cds)
control_genes_density <- compute_pam_density(all_spacers_cds_control_genes, control_genes_cds)

# Pearson correlation: PAM count vs CDS length (expected ~0.9 — longer CDS → more PAM sites)
cat("Pearson r (removed genes):",
    cor(removed_genes_density$num_pam_site, removed_genes_density$total_cds_length_bp), "\n")
cat("Pearson r (control genes):",
    cor(control_genes_density$num_pam_site, control_genes_density$total_cds_length_bp), "\n")

# Both groups show r ≈ 0.90–0.92: longer CDS → more PAM sites, so raw count is not
# informative on its own. We therefore compare density (PAM sites per kb of CDS).

pam_density_df <- bind_rows(
  removed_genes_density %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, pam_density) %>% mutate(gene_status = "removed genes"),
  control_genes_density %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, pam_density) %>% mutate(gene_status = "control genes")
) %>%
  mutate(gene_status = factor(gene_status, levels = c("control genes", "removed genes")))
```

### Figure 3E: Density distribution of PAM sites per kb of CDS

```{r pam-density-plot}

# Group medians — used for vertical reference lines
pam_density_medians <- pam_density_df %>%
  group_by(gene_status) %>%
  summarise(median_density = median(pam_density, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
# Median: control genes = 70.5,  removed genes = 64.6  (sites / kb CDS)

pam_density_df %>%
  group_by(gene_status) %>%
  summarise(median_pam_density = median(pam_density, na.rm = TRUE), n = n())

wt_fig3e <- wilcox.test(pam_density ~ gene_status,
                         data        = pam_density_df,
                         alternative = "two.sided")
cat("Fig 3E  W =", wt_fig3e$statistic, " p =", wt_fig3e$p.value, "\n")

pam_density_distribution <- ggplot(pam_density_df,
                                   aes(x = pam_density, colour = gene_status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) +
  # Dashed vertical lines mark each group's median
  geom_vline(data = pam_density_medians,
             aes(xintercept = median_density, colour = gene_status),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.7) +
  # Wilcoxon rank-sum p-value annotation
  annotate("text", x = 130, y = 0.028,
           label = paste0("Wilcoxon rank-sum\np = ", formatC(wt_fig3e$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)),
           size = 4, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, colour = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "",
    values = c("control genes" = "#1E88E5", "removed genes" = "#E69F00"),
    labels = c("control genes" = "Other protein-coding genes",
               "removed genes" = "Common genes with < 3 sgRNAs")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Number of protospacers with PAM-site per 1 kb", y = "Density") +
  guides(linetype = "none") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 15, vjust = 0.7, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), size = 15),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), size = 15),
    axis.line.x       = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.line.y       = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(size = 1.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.position   = "top",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  xlim(0, 210)

ggsave(here::here("figure", "Fig3E_pam_density_distribution.png"),
       plot = pam_density_distribution, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 1000)
```
